engineeringSkip.reason: A 'hive-mind neural mesh' built from quantum-entangled cortical relays is not grounded in known physics or neuroscience — entanglement cannot transmit information, and there is no research programme behind the claim.

factCheck.reason: Entangled particles cannot carry signals between brains, and nothing in neuroscience supports linking separate minds through implants, so the idea has no basis in known physics or biology.
